evidence.text: Gregory Fiennes, 10th Baron Dacre (25 June 1539, Hurstmonceaux, Sussex – 25 December 1594, Chelsea, Middlesex, England) was an English courtier.

evidence.text: He was the son of Thomas Fiennes, 9th Baron Dacre (c. 1515-1541) and Mary Neville.

evidence.title: Gregory Fiennes, 10th Baron Dacre
evidence.text: His father was convicted of the murder of a gamekeeper and hanged like a common criminal at Tyburn in 1541, and the aftermath the family was stripped of its lands and titles by Henry VIII.

evidence.title: Gregory Fiennes, 10th Baron Dacre
evidence.text: In the following years, his mother battled to have the properties restored on behalf of her children, and on her ascension in 1558 Queen Elizabeth restored the title of Baron Dacre to Gregory, his elder brother Thomas having died of the plague at age 15.
